proposals.evidence: DEDR4494 gives Kannada poṭṭe/poḍe/puṭṭi, Telugu/Parji poṭṭa and Gondi poṭa/poṭṭa belly. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
